title: Listening Drill — Market delivery plan
description: Public announcement. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Market delivery plan
sections.transcript:
ORGANISER: A quick update about deliveries to the Saturday market. Some of you have printed the original programme, so please take a moment to change your notes. The most important change concerns loading times.

ORGANISER: For now, go to the north ramp. If that route is closed when you arrive, use the service road instead. It takes a few minutes longer, so allow enough time.

ORGANISER: Questions should go to Jules rather than the general enquiries desk. Before you leave, display your permit in the windscreen. We will post a further update only if another part of the plan changes.
